_comment: Locations. id is added to LOCATION_ID_BASE and never reused (retired: 4, a pickup found inside a building that opens later, 2026-09-24). source says how the game marks it done: an EventControl event plus the global flag it sets (see agent_docs/MEASURED.md). The client sends a check when that flag becomes true. source.give, where known, is the |giveitem,type,item,...| that hands out the vanilla item on that map (type 0 item, 1 key item, 2 medal): the client keeps it out of the inventory and shows the seed's item instead. source.pickup is an item lying in the world (or buried in a dig spot): its flag is the pickup's own activationflag (agent_docs/MEASURED.md, "World pickups"), type is the item kind (0 item, 1 key item, 2 medal) and item its id; the client knows it by map and flag. Artifacts are events (no id): the game counts 7 artifact flags, and the goal is having enough of them. A location's requires lists event or item names it needs beyond its region. story_events are logic-only events (no id): a story step, placed in the region where it happens, whose item other rules require. requires is what the spot itself needs once you're in the room (the user, 2026-09-24: kept apart from what reaching the room needs, so entrance rando can change the second without touching the first); written even when the region already implies it. category marks a location a yaml option can leave out (quest: shuffle_quests). A story pickup (pickup.story: no activationflag of its own; its story event hides it for good) is known by the story event picking it up starts, source.event (the pickup's data[1]; the same whether the scene or the map made it), and its check is the flag that event sets; an option that skips that event can leave the location out. kept_open lists blockers the story puts up for a while (map, entity name); the client keeps them out of the way so an area with locations never closes (the user, 2026-09-24). A location may be marked done by a number slot instead of a flag: source.var and source.at_least (flagvar[var] reaching at_least), sent in slot_data as location_vars.

locations.name: Snakemouth Den: Lake, Ladybug Kid's Reward
Outskirts: Golden Path, Grass
locations._comment: Cut grass that drops an item copies its own one-time flag onto the drop (NPCControl.cs:5981-5983), so it's an ordinary pickup location. Item seen by the user in play (2026-09-24).

locations.name: Outskirts: Artis's Prize for Snakemouth Den
locations._comment: The first boss's prize (prize slot 0: flagvar[13], medal 5). The mod pays every prize as if Hard Mode were on, so it waits at Artis; his Event33 hands it over and sets the slot to 3 (MEASURED.md, Hard Mode boss prize medals).

locations.name: Outskirts: Ladybug Siblings' House
locations._comment: Indoors (inside 1, entity LadybugMistake); found by the user after the first boss (2026-09-24). The door (DoorLadybug) and the item carry no gate flags, but the user remembers the house locked earlier: requires the first boss until checked on an earlier save (logic may be stricter than the game, never looser).

locations.name: Ant Palace: Library, Bookshelf
locations._comment: A Lore Book hidden behind a bookshelf (the user, 2026-09-24; flag 71 in the play-through log).

regions.name: Snakemouth Den Underground
regions._comment: Every Snakemouth room with water droplets, or reached only through one (from the dump's doors: MushroomPit, UndergrondDoor, Underground*, TreasureRoom, Empty). Leif freezes the droplets (the user, 2026-09-24).

regions.name: Golden Path
regions._comment: BOGoldenPath: its door from outside the city requires flag 41, the first boss (gate table).

regions.name: Bugaria City
regions._comment: BugariaMainPlaza and AntPalace1: the door in from outside the city requires flag 107 (gate table).

regions.name: Ant Palace
regions._comment: The Ant Palace's rooms (library, war room, tunnels) and the city districts: their doors require flag 67 (gate table).

story_events.name: Leif Joins
story_events._comment: Leif joins the party at the Snakemouth Den lake (the MothEvent trigger starts Event14, which sets flag 16; MEASURED.md). The lake is reachable without passing any room with water droplets, so Leif comes before everything that needs him.

story_events.name: First Boss Beaten
story_events._comment: The first boss, in the treasure room (Event26 sets flag 41). After it, a ladybug girl outside the city starts the lost-kid quest (her flag 54); the kid then waits at the lake (MEASURED.md).

story_events.name: Entering the City
story_events._comment: Event60, started by the DoorBugaria trigger outside the city (hidden by 107); after the first boss, with Eetl.

story_events.name: Chapter 2 Start
story_events._comment: Event45, the AntPalace1 Chapter1StartEvent trigger (hidden by 67): chapter 2's title card.

kept_open._comment: Eetl turns the party back (Event12, which only walks the player and sets no flags) from the first boss (flag 41) until chapter 2 starts (flag 67), blocking the way back to Snakemouth Den (the user, 2026-09-24). Kept out of the way so the den's locations never close.
